# Version 4.155.0
> **Skia m155 previews** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews the Skia m155 renderer with updated image decoding and GLES interop. It updates HarfBuzzSharp and disables RAW and DNG decoding. Applications needing those formats should use a dedicated decoder before creating SkiaSharp images.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m155** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Skia m155 and incorporates the latest upstream m155 servicing fixes. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081), [#5196](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5196), [#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))

## API Surface

- **GLES interop uses pointer-based signatures** — Updates GLES interop signatures to pass native pointers directly, improving compatibility with native OpenGL ES integration. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## Bug Fixes

- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — SkiaSharp no longer attempts to decode RAW and DNG images. Applications that accept these formats should use a dedicated decoder before creating SkiaSharp images. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native library to version 14.4.0.

## Preview 2 (September 29, 2026)

Preview 2 added m155 servicing fixes, pointer-based GLES interop, and the HarfBuzzSharp update.
